newsitem.title: USA: Rockwell Int'l unit in China truck venture.
newsitem.headline: Rockwell Int'l unit in China truck venture.

text.p: Rockwell International Corp said Thursday its Heavy Vehicles Systems division formed a joint venture with China Heavy Truck Corp in China.

Rockwell said each partner will hold an equal stake in the Jinan Rockwell Axle Co, which will begin operations in Jinan, Shandong Province, January 1. The venture will make single-drive and tandem axles, front and rear vehicle assemblies and non-drive steer axles for heavy trucks.
Rockwell's business units provide industrial automation, semiconductor systems, avionics and automotive components.
Its stock was down 1/4 Thursday afternoon at 61-1/4.
